# Elon Musk sänker svenska storbolagen

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-10-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Dagens Industri's Kort och Lång hosts Robert Andersson and Ulf Petersson discuss a volatile week driven by the US: the Stockholm exchange bounced back as investors rotated out of AI stocks, after an FT report that OpenAI's revenue is about 30% below expectations hit Nasdaq. Ulf warns that the US rally is extremely narrow, with 32 stocks behind the entire gain, and that it depends on AI capex, which puts suppliers such as ABB and Atlas Copco at risk. On individual stocks, the hosts are bearish on property (Atrium Ljungberg) and positive on MTG after its sell-off and on NCC after the sale of its Industry unit. They are sceptical of the Prisjakt IPO, and SpaceX's move into mobile networks puts pressure on Telia and Tele2.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 ATRLJ-B — Atrium Ljungberg | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Robert is explicitly short Atrium and most office property stocks. Ulf sees no trigger until interest rates turn.

#### Reasoning

Q3 management result missed expectations, vacancy rose to 14.3% and LTV is at its 45% ceiling. Costs can't fall as fast as vacancies rise. The upward revaluation looked questionable as rates rose. The property index is down 20% YTD, and both hosts say there is no reason to buy property until the rate trend reverses.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the interest rate trend reverses downward
- if vacancy rate starts falling
- if LTV declines meaningfully

> *"Om jag börjar själv så ska jag säga att jag är nog lite kort i de flesta fastighetsbolag och kontorsbolag specifikt. Atrium är ett av dem. Jag är kort."*

---

### 🟢 MTG-B — MTG | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Ulf is long MTG after the 19% drop on the postponed Play Simple IPO. He calls it an overreaction, as nothing in the business has changed.

#### Reasoning

The sell-off came from a delayed spin-off, not from anything in the business. The Indian IPO is likely postponed only until Indian valuations recover. The stock trades on very low multiples after repeated falls. Risk: the whole gaming sector trades at low multiples.

#### Sell Triggers

- if operating performance deteriorates
- if Play Simple listing is abandoned entirely
- if gaming sector multiples keep compressing

> *"Jag är i alla fall lång MTG. Det är ett bolag som har fått alldeles för mycket stryk både idag och tidigare. Det är väldigt låga multiplar på det här."*

---

### 🟢 NCC-B — NCC | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Ulf is long NCC after the SEK 8.2bn sale of Industry to Heidelberg (about 40% of market cap). Robert is undecided but not short.

#### Reasoning

9x EBIT on peak Industry earnings is a good price. About SEK 7bn is released against an SEK 18bn market cap. A negative working-capital model means little capital is needed, so an extra dividend or buybacks are likely. The stock is down about 30% YTD. Robert notes that Industry was a high-margin segment, so the remaining business is less attractive, and the stock has given back its initial gain.

#### Sell Triggers

- if proceeds are not returned via extra dividend/buyback
- if remaining construction margins weaken
- if infrastructure demand slows

> *"Så då kan jag tänka mig att det kommer bli extrautdelningar eller kanske ett långsiktigt aktieåterköp. Och det tror jag skulle gynna den aktien på riktigt."*

---

### 🟠 KINV-B — Kinnevik | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up 3-4% today. Ulf says they should take a closer look at Kinnevik, which is likely seeking cash-generating, dividend-paying holdings.

#### Reasoning

The hosts compare SpaceX's cash-cow strategy to the old Kinnevik/Tele2 model. Kinnevik is showing momentum and may be looking for operating companies with dividends. They flag it for closer study rather than taking a position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Kinnevik fails to add cash-generating holdings
- if momentum reverses

> *"vi ska nog titta närmare på Kinnevik"*

---

### ⛔ NVDA — Nvidia | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Ulf questions whether Nvidia's roughly SEK 60,000bn value can ever be justified and would rather own farmland. OpenAI's revenue miss threatens the capex chain.

#### Reasoning

Steady-state profit of SEK 6-7trn would be needed to justify the value. Its growth depends on OpenAI and Anthropic continuing to invest, and OpenAI's revenue is reportedly 30% below expectations. A very narrow market rally adds fragility.

#### Sell Triggers

- if OpenAI/Anthropic revenue growth reaccelerates and validates AI capex

> *"Vill du äga 13 procent av all jordbruksmark eller vill du äga ett Nvidia som var i kris för 15-20 år sedan så skulle jag nog välja marken."*

---
